title: VTG 1996 Portugal Hand-Painted Ceramic Cottage Figurine – Country House Scene
descriptionText: The VTG 1996 Portugal Hand-Painted Ceramic Cottage Figurine is a charming addition to any collector's display, with its quaint country house scene hand-painted with intricate details. This figurine captures the essence of a traditional cottage from 1996, making it a unique and nostalgic piece for enthusiasts of villages and houses decor. Made in Portugal, this ceramic figurine showcases a timeless country style that is sure to bring a touch of whimsy to any holiday or seasonal decor setting.
